name: Klöckner & Co SE
summary: Klöckner & Co SE, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the distribution of steel and metal products in Germany, Switzerland, France, the United States, and internationally. It operates through two segments: Kloeckner Metals Americas and Kloeckner Metals Europe. The company offers steel flat products; long steel products; tubes and hollow sections; stainless steel and high-grade steel; aluminum products; and CO2-reduced steel, stainless steel, and aluminum products for building installations, roof and wall construction, and water supply.
